title: Antonio Villas Boas has intercourse with a humanlike woman
summary: Mike Masters tells of Antonio Villas Boas has intercourse with a humanlike woman, about 1957 at Brazil, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: also the fact that Antonio Vias boes had physical intercourse with this woman who he describes as a woman she looks a little bit different than women that he knew slightly higher cheekbones pointier chin

plain: A researcher named Mike Masters, on Jesse Michels's podcast, tells of Antonio Villas Boas, a man in Brazil who in 1957 says he had physical intercourse with a woman aboard a craft. According to Masters, Villas Boas described her as a woman who looked slightly different from women he knew, with higher cheekbones and a pointier chin. Masters raises it because, if true, it would suggest the visitors are close enough to humans to be related to us.
